title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1911. inv. no 123 (800) from the Mosque of Fatih, Trabzon, Turkey. 243 x 430 cm, fragment. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 52.
